title: servef walkthrough
description: POST this to /api/walkthroughs with Content-Type: application/json. Steps open a project's files and diffs in order, each narrated in Markdown. Unknown fields are rejected.

project.description: The project's absolute directory: a repository, worktree, or folder within the directories servef serves.

id.description: Stable ID. Posting the same ID again replaces the walkthrough. Omit it to get a new one generated from the title.

summary.description: Markdown introduction shown on the walkthrough's cover.

open.description: Open the walkthrough in a browser, unless servef runs with --no-open.

step.description: A step targets a file, a diff, or neither (a note).

body.description: Markdown narration shown beside the target.

lines.description: Inclusive 1-based [start, end]; use [n, n] for one line.

expect.description: Trimmed text the first line starts with. The UI flags the step when the line no longer starts with it. Recorded automatically for working-tree and branch targets when omitted.

at.description: Show the file as of this commit instead of the working tree.

path.description: A changed file's project-relative path; omit to open the compare at its first file.

side.description: Which side's line numbers lines use.

kind.description: working: uncommitted changes against HEAD. branch: base...head (three-dot). commit: a commit against its first parent. range: from's parent to to.

base.description: branch only: base branch; defaults to the detected base (origin's HEAD, main, master).

head.description: branch only: a local head branch; defaults to HEAD.
